name: Ashenveil Forest
description: A dark and cursed woodland. The trees seem to whisper.

rooms.name: Forest Entrance
rooms.description: A narrow path leading into the dark woods. The air grows cold.

rooms.name: Forest Path
rooms.description: Twisted roots snake across the path. Something watches from the trees.

rooms.name: Hollow Clearing
rooms.description: A small clearing with the remains of an old campsite.

rooms.name: Ancient Ruins
rooms.description: Crumbling stone walls covered in moss. An old figure sits among the rubble.

rooms.name: Goblin Camp
rooms.description: A makeshift camp littered with bones and crude weapons.

rooms.name: Dark Thicket
rooms.description: The trees grow so dense here that almost no light reaches the ground.

rooms.name: Cursed Grove
rooms.description: Dead trees surround a strange glowing flower. The air smells of old magic.

rooms.name: The Withered Heart
rooms.description: The heart of the forest. A massive wolf with glowing red eyes blocks the path.

name: Mossy Ravine
description: A deep ravine carved by an ancient river. Moss clings to every surface.

rooms.name: Ravine Entrance
rooms.description: A steep drop into the ravine. The walls are slick with moss.

rooms.name: Ravine Floor
rooms.description: The bottom of the ravine. Water trickles between the rocks.

rooms.name: Rocky Alcove
rooms.description: A sheltered alcove in the ravine wall. Someone left supplies here.

rooms.name: Ravine Cave
rooms.description: A small cave carved into the ravine wall. Glowing eyes peer from the dark.

rooms.name: Wolf Den
rooms.description: A den carved into the ravine wall. The smell of wet fur fills the air.

rooms.name: Ravine Depths
rooms.description: The deepest part of the ravine. Almost no light reaches here.

rooms.name: Mossy Grotto
rooms.description: A beautiful grotto covered in luminescent moss. It feels peaceful despite the danger.

rooms.name: The Ravine King
rooms.description: A massive clearing at the end of the ravine. A goblin of enormous size sits upon a throne of bones.

name: Bogwater Marsh
description: A fetid swamp filled with murky water and twisted trees.

rooms.name: Marsh Edge
rooms.description: The edge of the swamp. The ground grows soft and wet underfoot.

rooms.name: Bogwater Path
rooms.description: A narrow path through the marsh. The water is black and smells of rot.

rooms.name: Dry Island
rooms.description: A small island of dry land in the middle of the marsh. A relief from the mud.

rooms.name: Witch's Hut
rooms.description: An old hut perched on stilts above the swamp water. A cloaked figure waves you over.

rooms.name: Deep Marsh
rooms.description: The heart of the swamp. Fog rolls across the water.

rooms.name: Sunken Ruins
rooms.description: Ancient ruins half submerged in the swamp water.

rooms.name: Dead Grove
rooms.description: A grove of dead trees standing in the swamp water. Something circles beneath the surface.

rooms.name: The Black Pool
rooms.description: A massive pool of black water. Something enormous surfaces from the depths.

name: Crumbling Outpost
description: The ruins of an old military outpost. Now overrun with goblins.

rooms.name: Outpost Gates
rooms.description: The rusted gates of the old outpost hang open. Goblin graffiti covers the walls.

rooms.name: Courtyard
rooms.description: The central courtyard of the outpost. Goblins have made camp among the ruins.

rooms.name: Old Barracks
rooms.description: The old soldiers barracks. Rusty weapons and old armour litter the floor.

rooms.name: Armory
rooms.description: The old armory. Most weapons are rusted beyond use but a merchant has set up shop.

rooms.name: Watch Tower
rooms.description: The old watch tower. Goblins peer down from the battlements.

rooms.name: Outpost Dungeon
rooms.description: The dark cells beneath the outpost. Something howls from the darkness.

rooms.name: Deep Cells
rooms.description: The deepest part of the dungeon. The air is thick with the smell of blood.

rooms.name: The Warlord's Chamber
rooms.description: A large chamber at the heart of the dungeon. A massive goblin warlord sits on a throne of skulls.

name: The Goblin Warren
description: A vast underground network of tunnels dug by goblins over centuries.

rooms.name: Warren Entrance
rooms.description: The entrance to the goblin warren. The smell is overwhelming.

rooms.name: Main Tunnel
rooms.description: The main tunnel of the warren. Crude torches light the way.

rooms.name: Goblin Nest
rooms.description: A large chamber filled with goblin sleeping mats. A few items lie abandoned.

rooms.name: Shaman Shrine
rooms.description: A small shrine tended by goblin shamans. Strange energy fills the air.

rooms.name: The Fighting Pit
rooms.description: A large underground pit where goblins force captured wolves to fight.

rooms.name: Deep Warren
rooms.description: The deepest tunnels of the warren. Only the strongest goblins live here.

rooms.name: Goblin Treasury
rooms.description: The goblin treasury. Mountains of stolen gold and items fill the room.

rooms.name: The Warren King's Throne
rooms.description: The throne room of the Goblin Warren King. He sits atop a mountain of bones.
